per_object_cap.notes: No per-request size ceiling is published; traffic is sold by the gigabyte, so volume, not object size, carries the cap.

retention.stated: not applicable to traffic: a session or an address, not stored bytes. The one 60-day clock in the product is on prepaid credits, which expire 60 days after being added.
retention.notes: days is null because the 60-day clock destroys a credit balance, not stored bytes. The clock is recorded in limits[] as retention-clamped, where it binds.

egress.terms: Traffic out is billed by the gigabyte and nothing is unmetered: Builder $200/month at $3.00/GB Tier 1, Team $500/month at $2.20/GB, Scale $1,500/month at $1.50/GB, Enterprise from $0.85/GB, and the free Sandbox at $5.00/GB because it includes no credits.
egress.free_allowance: none: Sandbox has no subscription fee and includes no credits

interface_detail: Proxy transport: HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5. Control: a REST API for packages, sessions, analytics and API keys. Package guardrails set who can access a package, traffic caps, protocol limits and domain allow and block lists; targeting by country, region, city, ISP or ASN. No interface term names a proxy transport, so the transports are listed here.
tooling: Any HTTP client that can use an HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy; the page names Selenium, Puppeteer and Scrapy integrations. The REST API documented at developers.soax.com covers packages, sessions, analytics and API keys, for example POST /v1/proxy/analytics/summary, GET /v1/proxy/packages and POST /v1/api-keys/, with keys restricted to packages.
chaining: The Worker's AI gateway sends its outbound fetches through a SOAX mobile endpoint, so the request leaves from a carrier address while the compute stays on Cloudflare; SOAX carries traffic only, and the mobile IP is the identity the target sees.

limits_note: Plan limits: 2, 3, 5, 7 and 10 proxy packages and 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 team members on Sandbox, Builder, Team, Scale and Enterprise. Each package has its own authentication, routing, access rules, limits and usage tracking. Without postpaid billing, usage stops when the prepaid credit balance reaches zero; postpaid billing is limited to verified business accounts. No per-request or per-IP rate is published.
binding_note: Volume can be bought at every plan size, so the first limit to bite is the credit clock: credits added on Sandbox or a monthly plan expire 60 days after they are added (12 months on an annual plan). The kind is retention-clamped, applied to a credit balance rather than to stored bytes.

identity_cost.detail: A Sandbox account is free to open with no credit card, but it carries no credits, so any traffic needs a purchase paid by card, by bank transfer, or by crypto after KYC. Identity verification through the dashboard is a condition of any purchase or paid service; The platform is primarily for business use (B2B): individuals acting in a personal or consumer capacity may be declined, and business verification may be required at any time.

reliability_note: Sessions keep one mobile IP across multiple requests or rotate per request, after N requests, after a set time or on error; a sticky session locks requests to a single node with no rotation. The network covers 195+ countries with over 191 million residential and mobile IPs. Suspension, throttle and data loss on the mobile network: unverified.
confidence_note: Documented: plan prices, per-GB rates, credit expiry, protocols and the identity gate are quoted from SOAX's pricing page, mobile-proxy page, terms and KYC/KYB policy captured on 2026-10-30. The measured rung needs a gigabyte counted through a mobile session, which needs a paid account.

price_per_tb_month: USD 5.00 per GB Tier 1 on Sandbox, USD 3.00 on Builder, USD 2.20 on Team, USD 1.50 on Scale, from USD 0.85 on Enterprise; the vendor prices per GB and publishes no per-TB figure
notes: One rate covers residential and mobile traffic. Plans: Sandbox free with no included credits; Builder USD 200/month + VAT with 200 credits; Team USD 500 with 500; Scale USD 1,500 with 1,500; Enterprise USD 3,000 with 3,000. Tier 1 rates are USD 5.00, 3.00, 2.20, 1.50 and from 0.85 per GB; Tier 2 USD 4.00, 2.25, 1.65, 1.15 and from 0.55; Tier 3 USD 2.00, 1.20, 0.90, 0.60 and from 0.35. The geo tier follows the country of the egress IP (United States tier 1, India tier 2). Usage counts data in both directions, including partial responses, retries and interrupted connections; one GB is one billion bytes. Enterprise Monthly applies volume bands per tier, for example Tier 1 at 0.85, 0.75 and 0.50 credits/GB for the first 5 TB, the next 10 TB and the rest. Enterprise Annual needs business verification and a signed 12-month agreement.
